items.title: The 5 PM Slide Deck Disaster
items.description:
Leo has 10 minutes to pitch his slides, but his overactive brain is convinced every minor mistake will trigger social ruin. Watch Mia try to keep him grounded using blunt roasts, cold brew, and an absurdly loud dolphin laser pointer. Can a little psychological understanding help Leo survive the scariest 5 PM of his life?
